assistant_message.content: I’ll add a private access-attempt alert so you are notified if someone tries to open the Curate Portfolio area without the required owner permissions.

I can set this up in either of these ways. Both keep the curator data private and notify only you.

| Option | What you receive | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|
| **Immediate alert** | A notification for every denied attempt to open Curate Portfolio or call a curator-only action | Most visibility, but repeated scans or refreshes can create noise |
| **Rate-limited alert** | One notification per visitor/path within a short window, while still recording each denied attempt | Cleaner notifications; repeated attempts are grouped |

I recommend the **rate-limited alert** approach. It would alert you when someone is denied access, without including curator content or sensitive personal data. Which option would you like?
